comtrade_block_a_raw.description: Russian non-gas energy (Coal, Crude oil, Refined petroleum)

comtrade_block_b_raw.row_direction_disjunction: (trade_flow == 'import' AND reporter_code != 'RUS' AND partner_code == 'RUS') OR (trade_flow == 'export' AND reporter_code == 'RUS' AND partner_code != 'RUS')

eq7_unit_specific_loadings.why_donors_included: Donors' loadings are needed when they enter downstream counterfactual-placebo constructions and are used to enforce the design's symmetric treatment of the estimation set S_Y.

eq8_covariate_loadings.why_only_targets: Donors' post-2013 covariates are directly observed; a simulated counterfactual covariate path is needed only for targets.

eqB1_donor_mean_proxy.formula: ybar_t = (1/|C_Y|) * sum_{j in C_Y} Y_jt ; f_hat_t = (1, ybar_t)'

eqB8_counterfactual_outcome.formula: Y_hat_{it}(inf) = X_hat_{i,t-1}(inf)' beta_hat + gamma_hat_i' f_hat_t ; t >= 2014

reconstruction: B11: coalition average ATT_W = mean over i of g_bar_i,W
B12: baseline b_hat_i = mean over 2019-2021 of g_it
B13: incremental ATT_Inc,2 = mean over i of (mean_{2022-2024} g_it - b_hat_i)

B1_country_history_bootstrap.invalid_resample_policy: Redraw only a sampler ResamplingDegeneracyError or a nonfinite refitted statistic; require at least two target occurrences and two distinct original donors; accept finite rank-deficient factors through the Appendix B pseudo-inverse; propagate schema, programming and refit exceptions; stop at 500 accepted draws or 2500 attempts and retain the full rejection ledger. Flag a discard fraction above 0.10 of attempted draws.

B2_region_block_bootstrap.invalid_resample_policy: Redraw only a sampler ResamplingDegeneracyError or a nonfinite refitted statistic; require at least two target occurrences and two distinct original donors; accept finite rank-deficient factors through the Appendix B pseudo-inverse; propagate schema, programming and refit exceptions; stop at 500 accepted draws or 2500 attempts and retain the full rejection ledger. Flag a discard fraction above 0.10 of attempted draws.

G0_treatment_coding_resolution.selection_rule: lowest_priority_rank; earliest publication/entry ordering only when no equal-rank conflict; conflicting evidence requires recorded adjudication
G0_treatment_coding_resolution.secondary_material_rule: Any ledger entry with priority_rank >= 4 is rejected unless a priority_rank <= 3 entry exists for the same (country_code, policy).
G0_treatment_coding_resolution.conflict_rule: Equal-priority disagreement in entry_year or coding_decision raises unless exactly one top-priority record is adjudication_selected or a consistent adjudicated_entry_year identifies one top-priority record; a nonblank adjudication_note is mandatory. An adjudicated year need not be the earliest.
G0_treatment_coding_resolution.output: binary indicators S_it for sanctions and A_it for direct_arming; one entry per country-policy from the resolved ledger.

statistics.trimmed_mean_10pct: mean of d_i after removing the smallest 10% and largest 10% of the N_T country-level contrasts

F4_factor_proxy_variants.stability_flagging_rule: Any factor proxy specification with condition number > 1000 must be flagged as numerically unstable in downstream reporting; its ATT is a diagnostic not an alternative estimate.

I1_pointwise_ribbon_figure2.per_year_construction: at each available t in {2001, ..., 2024}: se_t = sd_i(g_hat_it) / sqrt(N_T); ribbon_t = (mean_i(g_hat_it) - 1.96*se_t, mean_i(g_hat_it) + 1.96*se_t); fitted year 2000 is unavailable under the lagged grid
I1_pointwise_ribbon_figure2.normalization_rule: subtract gap at 2013 from all years

exposure_heterogeneity_model.rate_outcome_unit_convention: percentage_points (do NOT multiply by 100; rate outcomes reported in this regression are already in percentage-point units, in contrast to the ATT tables where rates are expressed as decimals)

bootstrap_inference.invalid_resample_policy: Redraw only a sampler ResamplingDegeneracyError or a nonfinite refitted statistic; require at least two target occurrences and two distinct original donors; accept finite rank-deficient factors through the Appendix B pseudo-inverse; propagate schema, programming and refit exceptions; stop at 500 accepted draws or 2500 attempts and retain the full rejection ledger. Flag a discard fraction above 0.10 of attempted draws.

figure_2_dynamic_CCEDID_gaps.notes_required: Values before 2013 are normalized fitted gaps, not treatment leads.

figure_3_european_heterogeneity.notes_required: Colour scale extends to +/-0.18 so CPI estimates around 0.17-0.18 are not silently capped.

figure_4_matched_design_paths.notes_required: Baseline path includes pointwise band; high-income and Mahalanobis paths shown as lines to avoid visual clutter.

wdi_vintage.detection_rule: Fail the pipeline if the 129-country retained set, or the raw missing-cell counts, deviate from the manuscript's targets.

methodological_notes.estimand_interpretation: The ATT is the equally weighted average counterfactual gap among the countries in the estimation target group. Countries receive equal weight regardless of population or economic size.
methodological_notes.incremental_vs_level_estimand: Wave-2 level ATT is a total post-2022 gap vs non-participation. The preferred incremental contrast subtracts each country's 2019-2021 mean gap from its 2022-2024 mean gap.
methodological_notes.coefficient_ordering_property: The incremental post-2022 CPI effect (0.072) exceeds the Wave-2 level ATT (0.022) because the coalition entered 2022 from a negative Wave-1 position. The incremental captures the upward trajectory from that starting point; the level ATT measures final standing relative to the zero-deviation baseline.
methodological_notes.stable_gap_assumption_content: Inherited baseline (2019-2021) can be nonzero; no further post-2021 drift in that inherited baseline or in the mean counterfactual prediction error.
causal_interpretation_conditions: Donor factor captures common shocks relevant to coalition members
Timing, anticipation, and spillover conditions hold
three_interface_invariants: No target-country post-2013 realization enters its own counterfactual
No treatment information enters eligibility or imputation rules
Robustness branches never replace the baseline estimate
methodological_notes.stars_source_rule: Main-table significance stars come from the country-dispersion SE. Bootstrap and placebo outputs are complementary diagnostics only.
methodological_notes.cost_bundle_interpretation: Estimates capture realized path of coalition members under the 2022 bundle (legal sanctions + supply cuts + reallocation + compensation), not the ceteris-paribus effect of any single legal instrument.
methodological_notes.not_a_success_or_failure_verdict: Evidence of sender costs does not establish that sanctions failed or reduced welfare. Full assessment would require evidence on costs to Russia and strategic benefits of coalition participation, neither of which is estimated.
methodological_notes.exposure_gradient_not_mediation: The exposure regressions identify conditional associations within the coalition. They do not constitute a formal mediation analysis.
methodological_notes.no_household_incidence_estimated: The paper does not estimate household or firm incidence of the price increase; only national aggregates.
methodological_notes.no_replication_archive: The arXiv submission contains manuscript and figure files only. No replication archive is provided.

configuration_documentation.header:
# ==============================================================================
#
#  Two-Wave Common Correlated Effects Imputation for Coalition Burden
#  Price Levels, Real Output, and Pre-Escalation Russian-Energy Exposure
#
#  Complete Study Parameters, Runtime Bindings, and Provenance Requirements
#
#  This configuration specifies the analytical and reproducibility parameters
#  of the Python research pipeline implementing "Do Sanctions Backfire? New
#  Evidence on the Macroeconomic Effects of Supporting Ukraine" by Vicente
#  Rios, Izaskun Barba, and Lisa Gianmoena (2026). It preserves every parameter
#  in the supplied revised specification and records identified corrections.
#  The companion study_config.json encodes exactly the same data mapping.
#
#  Core Methodological Components:
#  - Eligibility is fixed using raw 2000--2024 observations before completion;
#    treatment assignments and estimated effects do not determine eligibility.
#  - Audited, within-country deterministic completion precedes construction of
#    the balanced 129-country panel and its eight one-year-lagged controls.
#  - Policy/outcome-specific never-treated donor means and a constant provide
#    the parsimonious two-component common-factor proxy.
#  - Factor-adjusted pooled coefficients and country-specific loadings are
#    estimated over 2001--2013. Untreated post-2013 paths use simulated target
#    covariates and donor factors, excluding realized post-treatment targets.
#  - Equally weighted level gaps cover 2014--2021 and 2022--2024. The preferred
#    incremental contrast subtracts each country's 2019--2021 mean gap under
#    the maintained stable-gap continuation assumption.
#  - Country-dispersion Student-t inference supplies the main-table stars.
#    Whole-country and region-block bootstraps re-estimate the design; finite-
#    draw-corrected, size-matched placebo tail probabilities are diagnostics.
#  - Russian-energy monetary imports and nominal GDP are aggregated within
#    2018--2021 and 2010--2013 after primitive-component completion; ratios
#    are recomputed from components rather than directly interpolated.
#  - Sample-standardized exposure interactions use country-clustered covariance
#    and the full covariance contribution for the total coalition gradient.
#  - Matching, influence, donor, factor, reference-window, and distributional
#    diagnostics retain separate branches and never replace the baseline.
#
#  Technical Specification Features:
#  - All 19 supplied sections, equation entries, algorithm labels, schemas,
#    series codes, targets, exclusions, and unresolved provenance slots remain.
#  - Five country rosters are transcribed from manuscript Tables A4/A6 and
#    cross-checked for policy overlap, donor membership, and the BIH exception.
#  - Covariate loadings have shape 2 x 8, consistent with F^+ X_i in Appendix B.
#  - Explicit reporting-window aliases match the notebook's runtime interface.
#  - Reproduction seed sets are documented implementation choices; they are
#    not represented as the authors' undisclosed random seeds.
#  - Plain YAML/JSON arrays replace Python tuples; no Python-specific YAML tags,
#    object constructors, secrets, or fabricated data-vintage values are used.
#  - Parameter annotations and a change ledger distinguish retained values,
#    manuscript-derived repairs, implementation choices, and unresolved inputs.
#
#  Fidelity Anchor:
#  latex_context.txt: main-text Equations (1)--(18), (A1)--(A2), and the printed
#  Appendix B tags B1, B3, B4, B5--B6, B7, B8; Tables 1--10, A1--A8, B1--B7.
#  B2 is absent; referenced B10--B13 are reconstructed from Equations (12)--(15).
#  A1--I1 algorithm names are implementation registry labels, not numbered
#  algorithms typeset in the manuscript. Numerical reference targets are
#  validation comparators, never substitutes for re-estimated results.
#
#  Scientific and Execution Status:
#  Operative bindings are remediated; authentic provenance remains pending.
#  The production gate must remain blocked until the WDI extraction vintage,
#  WGI release, and archived policy-source evidence have been supplied and
#  their concrete resolution artifacts registered. No empirical replication
#  or causal validity is established by configuration validation alone.
#  Source frames, geographic data, income groups, table authorities, and pinned
#  reconciliation inputs remain separate arguments to the pipeline.
#
#  Loading Contract:
#  1. Parse either file as the study_config mapping itself (no wrapper key).
#  2. Supply that mapping under data['study_config']; supply the ten raw source
#     DataFrames under data['sources']. The pipeline takes this data mapping.
#  3. orchestrate_study_pipeline binds runtime_inputs into a copy and rejects
#     conflicting duplicate declarations. Raw data and independent evidence
#     remain external inputs; missing provenance never becomes a ready token.
#  See records/evidence/configuration_remediation_validation.json for evidence.
#
#  Paper Reference:
#  Rios, V., Barba, I., & Gianmoena, L. (2026). Do Sanctions Backfire? New
#  Evidence on the Macroeconomic Effects of Supporting Ukraine.
#  E-journal submission: 11 September 2026.
#  arXiv:2609.12387. https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.12387
#
#  Source notebook: do_sanctions_backfire_remediated_draft.ipynb
#  Python implementation author: CS Chirinda
#  Configuration version: 1.1.0
#  Prepared for the project context dated 2 October 2026.
#
# ==============================================================================
